answer.summary: The Docker build fails in the front-end build stage: the Vite/rolldown production build reports 'Build failed with 7 errors', so the step exits 1. The log elides the individual errors, so the specific cause is unconfirmed. The build is deterministic and the changed files include many graph front-end files, so the change most likely broke it. Check the 7 errors locally with yarn build before re-running.
